name: Last Minute
source:
Mob is fed up with Reigen’s habit of calling at the last minute.

A fan-created game influenced by the manga/anime 'Mob Psycho 100'.

[From [url=https://nikapolitan.itch.io/last-minute]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
莫布厌倦了雷根在最后一刻打电话的习惯。

一款受漫画/动画《灵能百分百》影响的粉丝创作游戏。

[来自[url=https://nikapolitan.itch.io/last-minute]Itch.io[/url]]
